title: Build a ReAct Agent
blurb: Write the reason-act-observe loop yourself: parse model output, run tools safely, carry state, enforce a policy and grade whole trajectories.
intro: A ReAct agent alternates between a model that proposes the next action and ordinary code that executes it and reports back. The steps build the code half, using scripted model replies so everything is deterministic: a strict parser for the text format, a tool dispatcher that turns every failure into an observation, an immutable state update with a step limit, the loop itself, a policy check between decision and execution, and trajectory metrics that separate lucky answers from good runs. The capstone puts the policy inside the loop and evaluates the result.

steps.name: Authorise a tool call
steps.note: Authorisation is code between the model and the tool, never a prompt instruction.
